scope: Original production five-model GAME pipeline, sixteen-second geometry and eight diffusion steps; synthetic dense boundaries substituted only for bd2dur/estimator allocation stress. Not an analysis output or a quality comparison.

monitorQualification.reason: The command process used a PID namespace that did not match mounted /proc PID lookup; maxObservedRssBytes=307200 belongs to an incorrect PID and must not be used.
monitorQualification.trustworthyPeakSource: Node process.resourceUsage().maxRSS measured within the model process, multiplied by 1024. This value is independent of the failed external monitor.
monitorQualification.correctedWatchdog: rss-watchdog.cjs uses an independent Node worker thread and process.memoryUsage().rss, then process.kill(process.pid) in the correct namespace. Its deliberately low-limit kill smoke passed; the model stress was not rerun.

correctedWatchdogSmoke.scope: An independent watchdog thread samples process.memoryUsage().rss; process.kill uses the process namespace directly.

limitations: Synthetic 16-second tiling of actual separated vocal PCM is a geometry and allocation stress fixture, not new real-song accuracy coverage.
Every-frame synthetic boundaries intentionally stress the estimator beyond the 43-note normal fixture; no claim that this extreme arises in ordinary singing.
Single Node process RSS is not an Android WebView memory measurement.
One passage was run; four-inference reuse and device allocator behavior still require lifecycle qualification.
